author: codex

policy.fitted_model: log(C_t/C_0)=-k*t; per-line regression through origin at 0/3/6h; unweighted mean of three line k
policy.primary_normalization: total ERCC count ratio within line
policy.sensitivity_normalization: median ERCC ratio to same-line t0, common spikes >=20 in all18 samples
policy.interval_scope: Student-t interval of three line slopes; conditional diagnostic, not total biological uncertainty
policy.input_assumption: Comparable ERCC input relative to recovered sample RNA across chase; exact spike amount/cell recovery unresolved
policy.selection_status: Exploratory technical eligibility for source-cell sensitivity profile, not humanMN calibration
